notes: Web 411 — CLOSE-SHUTS-TIMER + EXTRA-AUTO-SESSIONS (Nov 11, 2026). (1) CLOSE-SHUTS-TIMER (owner law, restated Nov 10; broken in his hands Nov 9 AND Nov 10): closing the shift shuts the timer down — no separate Stop, ever — and a closed day can never resurrect a running timer. The old close rules each read only this device's local sessions list and matched a finished entry by its start pin, so they missed the close-out that landed on a surface whose own tracker was idle: that close books the day as a COMPLETED DISPATCH and writes no sessions entry at all, and a finished entry sitting in the same pull's incoming records was never consulted when the tracker was judged — the phone's timer ran on and came back running after a full close/reopen. Now one closed-day proof (a finished entry naming the session's start, OR the day's dispatch standing completed) is judged against the local records and the pull's incoming records together, and the closed state wins at every seat: the sync pull (cloudsync), boot and the tracker tick and native-record adoption (app.js — a stale running record for a closed day is ended with idle facts, never adopted), and the native boot reconcile (shifttrack). A live day with no close proof anywhere is untouched. (2) EXTRA-AUTO-SESSIONS: one dispatch, one session. An auto-start now pins its session identity to the plan anchor itself — the very key the native day-arm was armed under — instead of a whole-second derivation up to a second later, so the arm's session and the web's session are one identity, not twins. Re-arming under a new key (a dispatch edit moves the plan — the start still follows the dispatch as edited) disarms the old native arm first, so no stale arm survives to seed a session at the old time. And a stop that finds its own session already booked by the closing surface stands everything down but writes no second entry, no second doc and no second Revenue line. Auto-start itself is unchanged: dispatch-driven, at the dispatch's time. Bench: tools/close-shuts-timer-v411-test.js 36/36 on this build (21 passed / 15 failed on pristine web 410 — every new assertion fails there); neighbours at pristine standings (v352 12/2 stale pins, v314 19/1, v303 24/0, dispatch-autostart 67/6, pullgate 30/1, v342 29/0, dispatch-shiftclose 46/0). IN-HANDS VERDICT OWED: close a day on any surface and the phone's timer must be stopped and stay stopped after a full close/reopen; one dispatch must read as one session, started at the dispatch's time as edited.
